operators.name: isin_forward
semantics: Computes mask[i] = true if x[i] is present in the values tensor, elementwise over all positions in x.
Broadcasting: x can be any shape, values must be 1D contiguous; result has same shape as x.
The comparison is exact equality of float32 values, matching torch.isin.
Input tensors are on CUDA; output allocated on CUDA with same shape as x.
Supports arbitrary strides for x, but values must be contiguous.

operators.name: maxpool2d_forward
semantics: Performs 2D max pooling using cuDNN with the given kernel_size, stride and padding, dilation=1, ceil_mode=False.
x must be contiguous 4D float32 CUDA tensor.
Output shape computed as floor((H + 2*padding - kernel_size)/stride) + 1 and similarly for W.
Equivalent to torch.nn.MaxPool2d with the same parameters.
x is [512,3,128,128] float32 CUDA, values is [10] float32 CUDA.
mask is [512,3,128,128] bool CUDA, elementwise true where x equals any value in values.
maxpool uses kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1, dilation=1, ceil_mode=False.
Result is [512,3,64,64] float32 CUDA, each output is max over corresponding 3x3 window (with zero padding).
Returns the pooled tensor [512,3,64,64] float32 CUDA.
